title: Warm Dense Indian Corn Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Indian dish featuring corn arepa filled with mozzarella cheese, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot, with a blend of umami spices and sous-vide technique, making it a crowd-pleaser and FODMAP-friendly
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit
In a pan, heat the ghee over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent
Add the grated ginger, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute
Stuff each corn arepa with shredded mozzarella cheese
Place the stuffed arepas in the tagine pot and add the cooked onion mixture and water to the pot
Seal the tagine pot and cook the mixture in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours
Remove the pot from the sous-vide machine and let it cool for 10 minutes
Serve the warm dense Indian corn tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
